questions.questionTextEn: Formation of delta is affected by :
questions.questionTextHi: [M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1993] Formation of delta is affected by :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Deep sea. Conditions which are favourable for the formation of the Deltas are as follows : The river must carry a large amount of sediments. The slope and speed of the river must not be strong enough to remove the sediments deposited by the river. The slope of the sea floor or lake at the river mouth must be gentle or flat. [M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1993]

questions.questionTextEn: The greatest delta of the world is formed by –
questions.questionTextHi: [41st B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1996] The greatest delta of the world is formed by –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Ganga and Brahmaputra. The greatest delta in the world is the Ganges Delta. The Ganges Delta is a river delta in Bangladesh and West Bengal, India. It is known as Ganges–Brahmaputra-meghna Delta or Sunderban Delta also. [41st B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1996]

questions.questionTextEn: At the mouth of which of the following rivers the 'bird's foot' type delta is formed?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2018] At the mouth of which of the following rivers the 'bird's foot' type delta is formed?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Mississippi. The Mississippi River forms a 'bird's foot' type delta at the Gulf of Mexico, while river Nile forms an Arcuate delta. [U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2018]
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (D) Mississippi। व्याख्या (28. Landforms by River — Landforms by River): The Mississippi River forms a 'bird's foot' type delta at the Gulf of Mexico, while river Nile forms an Arcuate delta. [U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2018]

questions.questionTextEn: Nobi and Kanto plains are located in which of the following countries?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2021] Nobi and Kanto plains are located in which of the following countries?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Japan. • The Nobi Plain is a large plain in Japan that stretches from the Central Part of Japan and is about 1800 sq. km in area. • Kanto Plain, also spelled Kwanto Plain, Japanese Kanto- Heiya, plain that is the most extensive lowland in Japan, located in central Honshu, facing the Pacific Ocean. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2021]
